verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de exposes a public API for notarization, incorporation, tax and trade registration, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack mentions a sandbox, test mode, test API keys, or a non-production base URL. The only documented endpoint is the production api.beglaubigt.de, and none of the evidence describes dry-run or isolated test behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
